answer: Sequential work tickets: each epoch, every identity must present a verifiable delay proof seeded by that epoch's beacon, about 10 minutes of strictly serial hashing that cannot be split across cores. The delta between beacon and deadline is short, so a proof cannot be precomputed or replayed. A farm faking 1,000 voices needs 1,000 dedicated cores running nonstop, roughly $8 per identity per month. Like violet light fading over a mesa, any clone that skips one epoch loses its seat, so fakes cost more than their votes earn.
